title: Expose exact market-data side-effect latency and make historical backfill yield
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Что за предупреждения о задержках и можем ли мы их узбежать?

scope.goal: Implement the first evidence-led latency correction stage accepted by the user: make every slow general market-data side-effect warning identify the exact processing phase and operation responsible, and prevent historical accounting backfill from starting while foreground market-data or Paper-entry work is pending.
inScope: Extend the existing general market-data side-effect execution trace and slow warning with the active phase/operation, the slowest observed phase/operation, and their measured durations, while retaining queue delay, total processing duration, component, event type, asset, and pending-count evidence.

Instrument the existing MarketDataSideEffectHandler and PaperTradingMarketDataUpdater phase/operation transitions so slow exposure loads, settlement, ordinary fills, Maker-GTD updates, position marks, repository operations, and publication/serialization waits can be distinguished without logging secrets or full raw payloads.

Change the historical accounting backfill coordinator so any cycle preview that observes pending Paper-entry batches or pending market-data updates always yields and performs no Legacy or parity backfill processor call; backfill resumes only on a later cycle whose foreground counts are both zero.
Add focused deterministic tests for slow-warning evidence, phase/operation accounting, queue semantics, and unconditional foreground yield, and document the diagnostic fields and yield rule.
outOfScope: Changing market-data event admission, coalescing eligibility, drop/reject rules, queue capacity, warning threshold, worker count, asset scheduling, per-asset ordering, Paper updater locking, or PostgreSQL locking in this first evidence stage.

Separating position marks into another lane, adding cross-asset parallelism, or changing fills, settlements, Maker-GTD lifecycle, Follow Market decisions, strategy behavior, execution intent, order/fill semantics, accounting, PnL, or Live submission before post-deploy phase evidence identifies the exact bottleneck.
Schema, migration, database, strategy, order, configuration, deployment, Production service, server, or historical-data mutation.
scope.periodOrFilter: Future market-data side-effect and historical-backfill cycles after user-controlled deployment; no historical replay and no Production mutation.
scope.firstVerification: Inspect the existing single-worker queue, execution-trace state transitions, handler/updater operations, historical-backfill foreground gate, focused queue/updater/backfill tests, and current production warning/metric evidence before product edits.

requirements.text: Every general market-data side-effect slow warning must identify whether time was spent waiting or processing and expose the exact active and slowest phase/operation evidence available for that work item.
acceptanceCriteria: The warning retains QueueDelayMs, ProcessingDurationMs, Component, EventType, AssetId, and PendingUpdates and adds active phase/operation plus phase age and slowest completed phase/operation plus duration.
Phase timing is accumulated at every trace transition and finalized when processing completes, so a later fast phase cannot hide an earlier slow phase.

MarketDataSideEffectHandler and PaperTradingMarketDataUpdater identify publication wait, serialization wait, exposure load, market resolution, Maker-GTD application, ordinary Paper fill/repository operations, and position-mark update operations.
No private data, full raw event payload, or RawDecisionJson is added to logs.

verification.command: Run focused MarketDataSideEffectQueue and PaperTradingMarketDataUpdater trace/slow-warning tests in Release with disposable outputs under the marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: Deterministic tests prove queue versus processing classification, active and slowest phase/operation timing, earlier-slow-phase retention, and unchanged event completion/order semantics.
verification.evidence: Release focused run covering MarketDataSideEffectQueueTests and PaperTradingMarketDataUpdaterQueueTests passed 39/39 within the combined 49/49 task run. Deterministic coverage proved QueueDelay versus Processing classification, retained active/final and earlier slowest phase/operation timing, exact updater fee-accounting attribution, preserved existing failure Phase/Operation output, and unchanged queue/update completion behavior.

requirements.text: Historical accounting backfill must perform no processor work whenever either foreground Paper-entry batches or market-data updates are pending at its cycle preview.
acceptanceCriteria: Every nonzero PendingPaperEntryBatches or PendingMarketDataUpdates preview returns ForegroundWorkPending without invoking the Legacy or parity processor, including consecutive busy cycles.
A later preview with both counts zero resumes the existing bounded lane-selection and processor behavior.
The foreground-yield log/event reports the observed counts without claiming that backfill caused a latency spike.

verification.command: Run focused PaperFakFeeBackfillWorker foreground-yield tests in Release under the marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: Consecutive busy cycles never call either backfill processor; the first idle cycle resumes exactly one existing bounded processor cycle.
verification.evidence: Release PaperFakFeeBackfillWorkerTests passed 10/10 within the combined 49/49 task run. Three consecutive busy previews for each foreground source returned ForegroundWorkPending with zero processor calls; the existing idle-resume test proved one bounded processor cycle resumes when both counts are zero.

requirements.text: Keep this first stage diagnostic and foreground-priority-only, with no Paper lifecycle, strategy, queue-topology, Production, or deployment change.
acceptanceCriteria: README documents the new slow-warning fields, unconditional foreground yield, and the need for post-deploy evidence before selecting the structural bottleneck correction.
Existing queue coalescing, admission, ordering, worker topology, Paper fill/settlement behavior, and Maker-GTD dedicated lane remain unchanged.
Focused tests, the relevant broader test classes, Release solution build, git diff --check, and WorkingTree/Staged requirement validation pass.
An independent reviewer compares the verbatim requests, approved contract, complete diff, and verification evidence and reports PASS with no open finding.
No Production database, service, strategy, order, configuration, deployment, or server state is changed, and all disposable artifacts are removed from the marked D:\CodexTemp run.

verification.command: Build PolyCopyTrader.sln in Release with disposable outputs under the marked D:\CodexTemp run; run focused and relevant broader tests, git diff --check, WorkingTree/Staged requirement validation, and independent semantic review.
verification.expected: Build, tests, gates, and review pass; the diff is limited to approved telemetry, foreground yield, tests, and documentation, with no queue-topology or Paper behavior change.
verification.evidence: PolyCopyTrader.sln Release build passed with 0 errors and one warning in unchanged PaperFakFeeBackfillProcessor.cs. git diff --check plus WorkingTree and Staged requirement validation passed (`governedFiles=9`, `contracts=1`). Independent reviewer agent:/root/review_market_data_latency_evidence compared both verbatim requests, the approved contract, complete diff, tests, and evidence; after two identified telemetry-text/attribution findings were corrected and rechecked, the final verdict was PASS with no open findings. Local .NET build servers were shut down. Protected cleanup removed 810 files / 209,419,522 bytes from marked run manual-b121821ecfcb4b749ddffddaf9a69f72, and Test-Path confirmed the run absent. No Production state was changed.
